deviation_note: This is an estimate based on standard single-filer federal, FICA, and MT state calculations. Actual withholding may differ based on your W-4 elections, pre-tax deductions, and other factors. Montana's standard deduction is actually 20% of AGI (min $2,830, max $5,660), not a fixed amount; this estimate uses the maximum, which understates tax for lower incomes.
